newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end marginally higher.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end marginally higher.

text.p: Swiss shares closed a cautious session little change, overshadowed by widespread concerns about further developments on global financials markets.
Dealers said U.S. consumer price data helped U.S. bonds, which in turn lifted Swiss shares. But early losses on Wall Street led to a reversal of most of the advance.
"There is still fear of a correction" one dealer said.
A trader noted that investors will be closely following Wall Street for further indications as to which way markets will move next.
The blue-chip Swiss Market Index gained 2.4 points, or 0.06 percent, to end at 3,860.0 and the all-share Swiss Performance Index (SPI) closed 0.38 points, or 0.02 percent, higher at 2,465.23.
Most-active Clariant closed unchanged at 572 francs, ending a two-day bull run after announcing on Tuesday it would acquire the speciality chemicals business of Germany's Hoechst in a merger.
Roche and Sandoz posted minor gains while Ciba registered shares fell one franc to 1,613.

Utility and industrial group Electrowatt jumped more than one percent to 518 francs amid speculation that CS Holding may be preparing to partially or completely sell its 44.9 percent stake in Elektrowatt. CS Holding declined comment.
